profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA. It describes itself as providing an Intelligent Content Management platform that brings together content storage, workflow automation, collaboration, and data security in a single system. The platform is designed to handle unstructured data such as lease agreements, finance documents, sales presentations, and employee handbooks, allowing teams to access, share, edit, and work together on content from inside or outside an organization.

Box's primary AI product is Box AI, which the company describes as enabling real-time summaries, deep analysis, and smart recommendations by connecting to AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Box AI is tracked in the Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings category and encompasses enterprise content AI, metadata extraction, governance, compliance, and retention policies. The company also offers Box AI Studio for customizing agents and building agentic workflows, an e-signature capability integrated directly into the content platform, and AI-driven security features including deep learning-based malware detection, automated classification, and access controls designed to support compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA requirements.

Box files with the SEC under CIK 0001372612 and trades under the ticker BOX. Its most recently reported annual revenue, per a 10-K covering the period ending January 31, 2026, was $1,177,253,000.
